name: guardtower
description: Standalone, in-depth, opt-in code review: pick which specialized facets (security, concurrency, data-safety, and more) to run against a change, fan them out as self-limiting reviewers, and reconcile their findings into one markdown report. Report-only — never edits code.

interface.shortDescription: In-depth, opt-in code review across selectable facets
interface.longDescription: Guardtower runs a deliberate, deep code review of a change — a diff, branch, or PR. You pick which review facets to run (security, concurrency, data-safety, API, and more); each runs as an independent, self-limiting reviewer, and their findings are reconciled into one markdown report. It is report-only: it tells you what each facet found and never edits your code.
defaultPrompt: Run a thorough guardtower review of my current diff
Do a security-focused guardtower review of this PR
